about: Doddy's project secrets: where each lives in 1Password and which hosts get it. References and names only, never values. ADR-493, docs/security/SECRETS_1PASSWORD.md.

notManaged.name: doddy-voice-token
notManaged.why: Second copy of the voice token server on a non-default branch; the app calls the Vercel one. Owner decision 11: suspend, then delete.

notManaged.name: doddy-gateway
notManaged.why: Second copy of the gateway on a non-default branch. Owner decision 11: check which gateway address the phone uses first.

supabase.note: The old functions in project doddy-gateway are being deleted by the owner (code saved in docs/archive/supabase-functions-2026-10-18). Not a sync target.

secrets.name: ELEVENLABS_API_KEY
secrets.rotate: Make a new key in ElevenLabs, put it here, sync and redeploy both hosts, then delete the old key in ElevenLabs. A host still holding the deleted key can't start voice or phone calls.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.rotate: Make a new key in the OpenAI project, put it here, sync and redeploy both, then revoke the old one. Plan: one key per service at the next rotation. The voice token server no longer uses it (9 Nov 2026): remove OPENAI_API_KEY from the Vercel project doddy-voice-token when you next touch it.

secrets.name: DODDY_SESSION_SIGNING_KEY
secrets.whyNotPushed: changing it signs everyone out and changes the Apple ids the server derives from it
secrets.rotate: Signs everyone out and changes the pseudonymous Apple subject ids. Rotate only with a written plan; never as part of a sync.

secrets.name: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN
secrets.rotate: Reset the token in Upstash, put it here, sync and redeploy. The server fails closed until it has the new token.

secrets.name: UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN
secrets.rotate: Only if the gateway uses Upstash directly; a Vercel Marketplace store sets KV_REST_API_* itself. Reset in Upstash, sync, redeploy.

secrets.name: GATEWAY_TOKEN_SECRET
secrets.whyNotPushed: changing it signs every device out of the typed assistant
secrets.rotate: Signs every device out and resets the hashed counters in the store. Rotate only on purpose.

secrets.name: GATEWAY_INVITE_CODES
secrets.rotate: A list, not a key: removing a code revokes that tester. Edit the list here, then sync and redeploy.

secrets.name: WAITLIST_ADMIN_PASSWORD
secrets.rotate: Change it here, sync, redeploy the site; the owner logs into the waitlist admin with the new one.

secrets.name: DODDY_SESSION_SIGNING_KEY
secrets.whyNotPushed: changing it signs every backend session out (Render generated the live value)
secrets.rotate: Signs every backend session out. Must differ from the voice server's key. Rotate only on purpose.

secrets.name: COMPOSIO_API_KEY
secrets.rotate: Make a new project key in Composio, put it here, sync and deploy, then revoke the old one. Connected accounts stay in Composio.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY
secrets.rotate: Make a new secret key in Supabase (Project Settings, API keys), put it here, sync and deploy, then delete the old one there. Used only to delete a person's sign-in when their Doddy account is deleted (ADR-818); never the web app's publishable key.

secrets.name: MONID_API_KEY
secrets.rotate: It spends Doddy's Monid wallet: revoke fast if it leaks. New key here, sync, deploy, revoke the old one.

secrets.name: DUFFEL_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.rotate: Duffel test key only (duffel_test_...) until live booking is approved; the server refuses to book with a live key. New key in Duffel's dashboard, sync, deploy, revoke the old one (decision 2026-11-11-flights-kiwi-search-duffel-booking).

secrets.name: APNS_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.rotate: Make a new APNs key in the Apple Developer account, paste the .p8 text into this Secure Note, update APNS_KEY_ID on the host, sync, deploy, then revoke the old key.

secrets.name: APPLE_SIGN_IN_PRIVATE_KEY
secrets.rotate: Make a new Sign in with Apple key in the Apple Developer account, paste the .p8 text into this Secure Note, update APPLE_SIGN_IN_KEY_ID on the host, sync, redeploy, then revoke the old key. Optional: without it, deleting a voice account can't revoke Sign in with Apple (ADR-524).

secrets.name: TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.rotate: Make a new token in Twilio, put it here, sync and deploy, then retire the old one. Texts and verify codes fail while the host has a retired token.

secrets.name: TWILIO_TASK_AUTH_TOKEN
secrets.rotate: Make a new token in the Poland-only Twilio subaccount for calls Doddy makes (ADR-500), put it here, sync and deploy, then retire the old one. While the host has a retired token, those calls can't be dialled and their Twilio webhooks fail the signature check. Unset, the server uses TWILIO_AUTH_TOKEN.

secrets.name: ELEVENLABS_WEBHOOK_SECRET
secrets.whyNotPushed: ElevenLabs makes this value for the workspace's post-call webhook; the host must hold exactly the value ElevenLabs shows
secrets.rotate: Regenerate the post-call webhook secret in ElevenLabs, put it here and on the host at the same time. Until both match, the server rejects post-call webhooks and answer cards fall back to the live transcript, at lower confidence.

secrets.name: MEMORY_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.whyNotPushed: a different value makes stored memory copies and call notes unreadable
secrets.rotate: Never rotate casually: there is no re-encryption migration. 1Password's job here is the backup copy.

secrets.name: ELEVENLABS_TOOL_SECRET
secrets.whyNotPushed: it must change together with the ElevenLabs workspace secret doddy_tool_secret
secrets.rotate: Change the ElevenLabs workspace secret and this value at the same time, or phone-call tools stop working.

secrets.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
secrets.rotate: New key in the Anthropic console, put it here, sync and deploy both, revoke the old one. Without it, news digests fall back to plain headlines and Doddy's Claude tools (ADR-564) say 'not set up'.

secrets.name: GNEWS_API_KEY
secrets.rotate: New key from GNews, put it here, sync and deploy.

secrets.name: DODDY_DEVICE_INVITE_CODES
secrets.whyNotPushed: optional: only needed to let a second device in (ADR-563); set it by hand when that happens
secrets.rotate: Change the codes on Render; devices already signed in keep their sessions until they expire (30 days).

secrets.name: CDP_API_KEY_ID
secrets.whyNotPushed: USDC payments are not enabled (ADR-737): no host holds this value and none should until the owner decides; set it by hand then
secrets.rotate: Make a new Coinbase CDP API key, put its id here and on the host, then delete the old key in the CDP portal.

secrets.name: CDP_API_KEY_SECRET
secrets.whyNotPushed: USDC payments are not enabled (ADR-737): no host holds this value and none should until the owner decides; set it by hand then
secrets.rotate: Make a new Coinbase CDP API key, put its secret here and on the host together with its id, then delete the old key. A leaked key can ask Coinbase for signatures from the payment account: delete it first.

secrets.name: CDP_WALLET_SECRET
secrets.whyNotPushed: USDC payments are not enabled (ADR-737): no host holds this value and none should until the owner decides; set it by hand then
secrets.rotate: Rotate in the CDP portal (it protects the account's signing); update here and on the host together. Never keep a balance the owner is not ready to lose.

secrets.name: UBER_DIRECT_CLIENT_SECRET
secrets.whyNotPushed: deliveries are off (decision 2026-11-12-uber-direct-deliveries): no host holds this value until the owner switches them on in Uber's test mode; set it by hand then
secrets.rotate: Add a new client secret to the Uber app (developer.uber.com → doddy → Setup → Add Client Secret), put it here and on the host, deploy, then delete the old one in Uber. Uber bills its account for deliveries made with it.

managed.name: DATABASE_URL
managed.note: Render builds it from the database; keep it there.

managed.name: BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN
managed.note: Set by the Vercel Blob store connected to the site.

managed.name: KV_REST_API_TOKEN
managed.note: Set by a Vercel Marketplace Redis store, if one is connected to the gateway.

retired.name: PICOVOICE_ACCESS_KEY
retired.why: Hey Doddy and Picovoice were removed from the app and the token server (ADR-549); remove the value from the Vercel project with --prune

retiredNote: DODDY_ACCESS_CODES (the old tester codes on the voice token server) goes here, with target vercel:doddy-voice-token, once every tester runs the signed-in build. Until then --prune has nothing to remove.
